response: "When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to 1962, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old serial killer case. The notorious 'Time Traveler's Terror' has been leaving a trail of bodies across the country, and Rachel's unique knowledge of future forensic techniques is the only hope for catching the killer. With the help of a local detective, Jack Harris, Rachel must use her skills to leave clues that will lead her modern colleagues back in time to prevent the killer's next move. But as the body count rises, Rachel realizes that the killer's true intention is not just to kill, but to alter the course of history. Can Rachel and Jack stop the Time Traveler's Terror before it's too late, or will the killer succeed in rewriting the timeline? 1. The year is 1962. 2. The killer has already claimed 5 victims. 3. Together, they uncover a web of deceit and corruption that goes all the way to the top. 7. The killer's next target is a prominent businessman with ties to the government. 8.
